Title: Warehouse Inventory Count — Aisle 12-14
Time: Thursday 14 March, 07:00–10:30
Description: Quarterly stocktake for the north warehouse, covering aisles 12 through 14 (paper goods and small appliances). Please bring your scanner and a charged tablet. Priya from ops will run the reconciliation against the cycle-count sheet afterwards. Note that the chatbot team is borrowing two of our handheld scanners that morning, so we've only got four to go round — let me know if you need one reserved. Coffee and pastries in the break room from 06:45.

Title: Review — PR #4821 (support bot reply templates)
Time: Friday 22 March, 15:00–15:45
Description: Quick walkthrough of Marcus's pull request that refactors the canned reply templates our support chatbot uses. The diff is mostly YAML moves plus a few renamed keys, but the fallback logic changed slightly so I'd like a second pair of eyes. Please skim the diff before we meet; comments welcome in the PR thread. We'll aim to merge the same afternoon if nothing blocking turns up.

Title: Support Desk Phone Upgrade — Rollout Planning
Time: Monday 8 April, 11:00–12:00
Description: The vendor is finally retiring the old desk handsets, so we need to plan the switchover for the customer-support floor (about 40 seats).

Agenda:

1. Confirm headset compatibility — the new Yealink units ship with USB-C only, so anyone on an older laptop may need an adapter. Dan has a list of affected seats.
2. Decide whether we keep the softphone as a fallback for the first two weeks. The chatbot handles most chat traffic now, but voice volume on Mondays is still heavy.
3. Schedule the desk-by-desk swap. Proposal: two afternoons, split by team, so we always have half the floor live.

Please bring your team's seat map and any call-volume stats from the last quarter. If you can't make it, send notes to the support-ops inbox and I'll circulate a summary by Wednesday.

intent.requested_action: attend the phone upgrade planning meeting

items.text:
Title: Inventory count sign-off
Time: Thursday 14 March, 11:00–11:15
Description: Fifteen minutes with Priya to sign off the aisle 12-14 count before it goes into the ERP. Bring the variance list.

Title: PR Review — payment retry logic (#4833)
Time: Tuesday 26 March, 10:00–11:00
Description: Jan asked me to shepherd this one since he's out until April. The PR touches the payment retry queue and the webhook handler, and there's a decent chance it affects how the support chatbot reports failed orders to customers. Sofia has already left comments on the retry backoff, so read those first. We'll go through the open threads together and try to get it to an approve by the end of the hour.

Title: Phone upgrade — support floor dry run
Time: Wednesday 17 April, 09:30–10:15
Description: Before the main rollout we're doing a dry run on six desks near the window. IT will swap the handsets and test inbound routing with the new firmware. If you sit in that row, expect a ten-minute interruption around 09:45 and please keep a headset nearby. I'll bring a checklist and the ticket template for logging anything that misbehaves. Questions to the support-ops channel, please, not the chatbot — it won't know about the phones until we update its knowledge base.

intent.requested_action: participate in the phone upgrade dry run

items.text:
Title: Pull request #4850 — quick approval
Time: Thursday 4 April, 16:00–16:15
Description: One-line fix to the chatbot's greeting string after the typo in yesterday's release. Should take five minutes to approve.

Title: Warehouse count — equipment handback
Time: Friday 15 March, 09:00–09:15
Description: Return the handheld scanners and tablets to the ops cupboard after the count, and sign the handback sheet on the door.

Title: Support Phone Upgrade — Training and FAQ Sync
Time: Friday 19 April, 13:00–14:30
Description: Two linked sessions in the same slot, back to back.

Part 1 (13:00–13:45): hands-on training on the new Yealink handsets. We'll cover transfer, hold, and conference, plus how to park a call while checking an order in the admin panel. IT will stay for questions at the end.

Part 2 (13:45–14:30): syncing our help-centre FAQ with the new call-flow language. Several articles still say to press 9 for the operator, which won't exist on the new system. I've drafted a spreadsheet of about thirty articles that need edits; we'll divide them up and aim to have everything updated before the Monday rollout.

Please read the FAQ draft beforehand — link is in the invite. If your team has an article you know is out of date, add a row to the spreadsheet before Friday morning. The update to the support chatbot's knowledge base will follow once the FAQ changes are live, so no need to touch that side yet.

intent.requested_action: attend the phone training and FAQ sync

items.text:
Title: Inventory Count — Planning and Prep
Time: Monday 11 March, 15:00–15:45
Description: A short planning session ahead of Thursday's count. Nothing heavy, but a few things to settle.

- Confirm the aisle assignments and who pairs with whom. Last time we lost twenty minutes because two people started on aisle 13.
- Check that the scanner firmware is current; the last update in February broke the barcode symbology for a day.
- Agree on how we log damaged items. The paper form worked fine, but Priya wants to try the tablet form this quarter.

We'll also skim last quarter's variance report so everyone knows where the usual discrepancies are. If you can't attend, reply with your preferred aisle pairing and I'll add it to the sheet. The customer-support chatbot summary of the last count is in the shared drive if you want context — it's a bit long-winded but accurate.

intent.requested_action: attend the inventory count planning session
